items.prompt: Both option prices pass their individual bounds. What remains possible?

options.text: They are proved uniquely fair prices
options.why: Bounds do not identify a unique model price.

options.text: Every venue will fill at those prices
A live arbitrage trade is authorized
The pair can still violate put-call parity
options.why: The12call/8putfixture passes ranges but has nonzero parity gap.

items.explanation: Necessary individual inequalities are weaker than the full cross-price equality and do not establish market execution.
